summary: Greed: wanting more. The first of the three roots of harm, 貪瞋癡.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Newton–Leipnik trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 魂 takes the highest of the eight points and 魄 the lowest, after the Liji’s 魂氣歸于天，形魄歸于地. A design choice, not a claim.

oc.note: Placeholder, NOT an Old Chinese reconstruction. Consult Baxter–Sagart 2014 before entering a form.

satellites.title: The First Root of Harm
satellites.evidence: The Abhidharmakośa: 世尊說為貪瞋癡三不善根 — the Buddha called greed, hatred and delusion the three roots of the unwholesome. 貪 renders lobha in this list, and rāga, passion, elsewhere.
